status: Offline ablations; no active R5 changes
sharpnessDefinition: PR171 sharp amount multiplied once; same radius, local contrast, noise threshold and ±3 sharpening-term cap. Added face exclusion/feather for all non-Brilliance variants.
limitations: Four independent scenes including one user diagnostic; no held-out/phone pairs
Brilliance changes face tone but excludes extra local clarity there
Vibrance preserves manually marked faces; warm-color attenuation is heuristic
High-frequency RMS includes true texture and artifacts; MSE is not preference
